use_case: Customer-service chatbot with account access (web and app chat): answers billing, outage, and plan questions and takes allow-listed account actions through the BSS API after the customer signs in
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (SaaS on a large language model platform)
build_or_buy: Buy (configured with company knowledge articles and an API connector)
data_categories: Customer messages; account data including CPNI (call detail lines, voice plan, voice bill lines); chat transcripts
consequential_decision_category: None (payment arrangement offers come from fixed BSS rules; credits, deposits, and disconnections stay with agents)
human_in_the_loop: Customers can reach a person at any time; agents handle credits, disputes, disconnections, and authentication changes; account changes need customer confirmation
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2001-64.2011 (C-COMMUNICATIONS-R01): 64.2010(c), (e) online authentication; 64.2007 approval before CPNI-based upsell; 64.2011 for any unauthorized disclosure. FTC Act Section 5 for broadband statements. State breach laws (Florida worked example) if credentials are exposed
status: In production since 2026-02-09 (about 410,000 sessions a month)
cpni_access: Yes (read through the API after sign-in)
protected_characteristic_inputs: None collected; language recorded per session
bias_testing_status: Local testing by language and customer type (disparity found)
monitoring: Monthly 200-transcript accuracy sample by language; weekly allow-list exception report; quarterly red-team

use_case: Agent assist: real-time call transcription, summary, and suggested next steps for care agents
data_categories: Call audio; transcripts; account context including CPNI
human_in_the_loop: Agent reviews and edits every summary and decides every action
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2001-64.2011 (C-COMMUNICATIONS-R01): 64.2009(b) training; 64.2010(b) authentication still performed by the agent. Recording consent announcement (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example)
bias_testing_status: Vendor accuracy data; local sampling planned (P01 R-028)

use_case: Network anomaly detection and predictive maintenance alerts for the access network
vendor_or_model: Network analytics platform (vendor model, company-trained thresholds)
data_categories: Network telemetry; alarms; no customer content
applicable_laws: 47 CFR Part 4 if a missed or false alert affects outage response
monitoring: Monthly precision and recall against confirmed faults

use_case: Closed-loop remediation for broadband gateways and OLT ports (automatic restarts and reroutes)
vendor_or_model: Network automation platform with a vendor model
human_in_the_loop: Pilot runs in recommend mode; NOC approval required before any automated action outside one test region
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 4.9 (an automated action that causes a reportable outage must be reported); CPNI not involved
monitoring: Weekly review of every automated action; rollback tests

use_case: Identity and fraud risk scoring at account opening that can require a deposit or send an order to manual review
data_categories: Applicant identity data; device and address signals; consumer report data for some orders
human_in_the_loop: Declines and deposits above $200 go to an analyst; lower deposits are automatic

protected_characteristic_inputs: Address and device signals may act as proxies
monitoring: Monthly decline and deposit rates by service area

data_categories: Account and usage data, including voice CPNI for voice customers

applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2001-64.2011 (C-COMMUNICATIONS-R01): 64.2007(b) and 64.2009(a) (approval checked before use); 64.2009(c), (d) campaign records and supervisory approval
bias_testing_status: Offer rates by service area reviewed quarterly
monitoring: Quarterly model drift and approval-flag filter check

use_case: Collections prioritization and payment arrangement eligibility
business_owner: Vice President, Billing and Revenue Assurance
human_in_the_loop: A person approves every suspension; the model only orders the work queue and proposes arrangements
applicable_laws: State public service commission rules on suspension of regulated voice service, where they apply (counsel review); FTC Act Section 5
protected_characteristic_inputs: None; service area and payment channel can act as proxies
bias_testing_status: Disparity test by service area and language completed 2026-04 (no flag)
monitoring: Quarterly suspension and arrangement rates by service area and language
